bounded_claim: This deterministic successor test examines only whether the native AuthorityResolution representation requires at least one observation for an ESTABLISHED executable authority while preserving supplied-observation coherence. It does not establish observation authenticity, resolver correctness, source authority, distributed consensus, jurisdictional freshness, external provenance, or production deployment behavior.
controls: AuthorityResolution.established(active_authority) must remain valid with exactly one observation.
Direct ESTABLISHED construction with one matching observation must remain valid.
Direct ESTABLISHED construction with duplicate matching observations remains admissible; this successor does not introduce an exactly-one-observation invariant.
Direct ESTABLISHED construction with zero observations must be rejected at representation construction.
Direct ESTABLISHED construction carrying an observation unequal to executable authority must remain rejected under the earlier P3-F05-S01 coherence control.
governing_question: Does the P3-F06-S01 successor representation control reject an ESTABLISHED AuthorityResolution carrying zero observations while preserving valid established representations and the P3-F05-S01 supplied-observation coherence control?
title: Observation-Presence Containment
